target: Lesional macrophage AND oxidised-phospholipid dual recognition
role: Confines payload release to plaque macrophages (the AND gate)
precedent: Macrophage-targeted nanoparticles delivering an LXR agonist avoided hepatic lipogenesis while raising ABCA1/ABCG1
known_failure_mode: Off-target release: systemic CD47 blockade causes anaemia; systemic LXR agonism causes hepatic steatosis

role: Dissolves crystals and generates the endogenous LXR ligand that fuels M2/M3
precedent: Cyclodextrin dissolved cholesterol crystals, raised oxysterols and drove LXR-dependent regression of established plaques
known_failure_mode: A separate Apoe-null study failed to reproduce lesion regression; ototoxicity limits systemic cyclodextrin dosing

role: Exports the liberated cholesterol so the efferocyte survives its own meal
precedent: Abca1/Abcg1-deficient efferocytes die after engulfing apoptotic cells; efflux preserves viability during efferocytosis
known_failure_mode: Hepatic LXR activation causes lipogenesis and hypertriglyceridaemia

role: Restores clearance of the apoptotic cells that form the necrotic core
precedent: Cleavage-resistant MerTK gave smaller necrotic cores and thicker caps; CD47 blockade restored phagocytosis and regressed established lesions
known_failure_mode: Systemic CD47 blockade destroys red cells; MerTK signalling is profibrotic in liver, so the gate must hold

role: Stops re-loading the cell while it is being unloaded
precedent: Two-pronged nanoparticle (SR-A siRNA plus LXR ligand) reduced plaque free and esterified cholesterol more than either payload alone
known_failure_mode: Scavenger receptors also serve host defence; chronic knockdown may impair bacterial clearance

precedent: ADAM17-mediated MerTK cleavage impairs efferocytosis and resolution; inflammasome activity drives the cleavage
known_failure_mode: Infection risk with sustained inflammasome blockade (see ZEUS serious infections in the human IL-6 data)

role: Stops new cap micro-deposits while existing mineral matures to stable macro
precedent: Microcalcification tracks instability while dense macrocalcification is stabilising; statins reduce the microcalcified fraction as density rises
known_failure_mode: Removing mature calcium could destabilise the cap - the design must NOT attempt total decalcification

role: One-time editing shuts off the substrate supply for life
precedent: VERVE-102 gave durable 62% LDL-C reduction to 18 months; CTX310 gave 53% LDL-C reduction at one year
known_failure_mode: No outcomes data; base-editor off-targets need dedicated assays

precedent: CAR-Tregs against oxidised LDL reduced foam-cell formation and limited plaque development in mice
known_failure_mode: Foxp3 instability could convert tolerance into pathogenic effector cells
